Galio

the Colossus
Mid laneSupport lane

Galio is a strong engage support. With his taunt, knock-up and global ultimate, he can start fights, protect his ADC from divers, and join other lanes' fights from anywhere on the map. Easy to learn and great for players who like protecting their team.

When to pick Galio

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. His crowd control and tankiness make him useful in most bot lanes.

Pick into

  • Squishy supports, like Yuumi and Karma
  • Engage supports like Blitzcrank, whom he can punish with his taunt
  • Teams with magic damage
  • Teams with divers who jump on your ADC

Avoid into

  • Poke supports with long range, like Senna
  • Supports who block his engage, like Braum
  • Supports with strong disengage, like Nami
  • Teams with mostly physical damage

Great teammates

XayahHer root combos with your taunt.
Miss FortuneYour crowd control sets up her Bullet Time.
TristanaShe jumps in after your engage.

Your team needs: Pick Galio support when your ADC can follow up on engage and your team needs a frontline.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Two crowd control spells (taunt and knock-up) make engages easy
  • Hero's Entrance lets him help allies anywhere on the map
  • Very tanky against magic damage dealers
  • Strong peel for his ADC against divers and assassins

Weaknesses

  • Long-range supports can poke him out of lane
  • Not much healing or shielding for his ADC
  • His engage can be stopped by enemy crowd control
  • Weaker against physical damage champions

Power spikes

  • Level 2: E and W unlocked. Look for an engage before the enemy bot lane hits level 2.
  • Level 6: Hero's Entrance lets you help any lane.
  • Support item upgrade (Celestial Opposition): free through the support quest, more tankiness and engage power.
  • First item (Locket of the Iron Solari): shields your team in fights.
  • Second item (Imperial Mandate): your crowd control marks enemies for extra damage.

Top tips

  • Level 2 E plus W is a strong all-in. Look for it before the enemy hits level 2.
  • Don't take your ADC's last hits with Q or Colossal Smash.
  • Hero's Entrance can join your jungler's ganks: check the minimap often.
  • Taunt divers who jump on your ADC. Peel is as important as engage.
  • Use your quest's cheap control wards: keep the river and dragon pit warded.
  • Against poke supports, stay behind minions and wait for your engage window.
